

```{r library_load}
# Load Libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(cohortED)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

```

```{r unpack_parameters}
# Unpack parameters
content_area   <- params$content_area
target_grade   <- params$target_grade
grade_range    <- params$grades
dataset_input  <- params$dataset
achieve_var    <- params$achievement

# Derived narrative labels
subject_label  <- toupper(content_area)
grade_label    <- paste("Grade", target_grade)
previous_grade <- target_grade - 1

# Proficiency levels
proficiency_levels <- params$proficiency_levels
advanced_levels <- params$advanced_levels
n_proficiency_levels <- length(proficiency_levels)
n_advanced_levels <- if (!is.null(advanced_levels)) length(advanced_levels) else 0

```

```{r load_data}
# Load dataset from internal package or external file
dataset_input <- params$dataset
grade_range   <- params$grades

if (file.exists(dataset_input)) {
  df <- readRDS(dataset_input)
} else {
  data(list = dataset_input, package = "cohortED")
  df <- get(dataset_input)
}

# Safely convert GRADE to numeric
df$GRADE <- as.numeric(df$GRADE)

# Filter by content area (case-insensitive) and grade range
df <- df[
  toupper(df$CONTENT_AREA) == toupper(params$content_area) & df$GRADE %in% grade_range, 
]

```

```{r derive_years}
# Ensure YEAR column is parsed into numeric form
df$YEAR_NUM <- as.numeric(parse_year(df$YEAR))

# Get sorted list of available years
available_years <- sort(unique(df$YEAR_NUM))

# Stop if not enough years to compare
if (length(available_years) < 2) {
  stop("At least two distinct years are required for longitudinal analysis.")
}

# Identify key year points
current_year   <- max(available_years, na.rm = TRUE)
previous_year  <- sort(available_years[available_years < current_year], decreasing = TRUE)[1]
first_year     <- min(available_years, na.rm = TRUE)

# Optional: academic year labels
current_year_label  <- to_academic_year(current_year)
previous_year_label <- to_academic_year(previous_year)
first_year_label    <- to_academic_year(first_year)

# Dynamically obtain the achievement levels
achieve_levels <- if(is.factor(df[[achieve_var]])) {
  levels(df[[achieve_var]])
} else {
  levels(factor(df[[achieve_var]]))
}

```
